verdict.rationale: Termius documents several of its own bulk capabilities. It can broadcast input to all sessions in a workspace and run snippets on multiple hosts at once. It can import many hosts from CSV or ~/.ssh, and group-level defaults and jump hosts apply to every host in a group. missing for 10: no programmatic or API/CLI-driven bulk operations (no OpenAPI found), no documented bulk edit/delete of host or keychain entries, no independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-host execution.
